regions.text: freedom— symbolizing an end as well as a beginning— signifying
regions.explanation: From 10.62s to 16.37s (“freedom— symbolizing an end as well as a beginning— …”), 2 pause(s) at punctuation shrank from 1.01 s to 180 ms on average. Pauses at punctuation mark the end of an idea and give the audience time to absorb it; running through them merges separate thoughts into one stream. Fix: Hold a clear pause at each punctuation mark, about as long as the reference.
